comment: The catalogue of verticals. The hub renders its directory from this file at runtime, so adding an app is a data change, not a code change. slug must match the app's directory under apps/ and the __BH_APP_ID it declares, because a Pro subscription is matched against that id. status 'live' renders a full card; anything else counts toward the roadmap only — details are deliberately left blank until the app lands rather than guessed at.

apps.name: Casebook
apps.blurb: 207 terms, 217 exam vignettes with rationales, spaced-repetition drills, and a tutor that runs on your own device.
